ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Via Stdin - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated Powershell via Stdin in Scripts Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*set.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*")) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*environment.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*invoke.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\$\\{input\\).*")))
